recovery.note: rc.4 never reached publish. Its tag was cut on a branch commit and pushed, so `release:verify:tag-source` refused with 'Release tag v0.2.0-rc.4 is not reachable from origin/main' before any package was built. The tag is now locked to that commit by the `release tag immutability` ruleset (id 27438539), so it cannot be moved and this version line has to advance instead. Nothing was published under 0.2.0-rc.4; the registry still shows the last published packages at 0.1.1-beta.20 plus the three rc.3 stragglers named in firstPublish.

note: rc.5 also carries the component-analyzer fix (2d7bc699) that rc.4 introduced but never published: mergeEvents dropped events declared only under `meta.events`, which silently removed props from the generated React/Vue wrapper types. zeus-ui's headless examples cannot typecheck against any published version until this lands.
